from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class TaxesPayable(BaseModel):
    """One company's '应交税费' (taxes payable) amount for the period in question."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as stated in the report")
    securities_code: str | None = Field(description="The company's securities trading code")
    taxes_payable_amount: float | None = Field(description="The '应交税费' amount as reported")
    taxes_payable_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g., '元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    change_rate: str | None = Field(description="Year-over-year or period-over-period change rate if stated")
    change_reason: str | None = Field(description="Reason for change if stated in the report")
    quote: str = Field(description="Brief summary of the relevant line item from the report")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    taxes_payable_records: list[TaxesPayable]
